يشترفون (form VIII)
# يَشْتَرِفُونَ (yaštarifūna) /jaʃ.ta.ri.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
# يُشْتَرَفُونَ (yuštarafūna) /juʃ.ta.ra.fuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِشْتَرَفَ (ištarafa)
